name: stdf-skill
description: AI Skill package for building with STDF, Svelte 5 and Tailwind CSS 4.
author: any-tdf

scripts.test:theme: bun skill/scripts/generate-theme.mjs --preset STDF --format json && bun skill/scripts/generate-theme.mjs --random --seed 1 --name MyTheme --format plugin && bun skill/scripts/generate-theme.mjs --primary 'oklch(0.52 0.24 35)' --dark 'oklch(0.72 0.18 250)' --format both
scripts.test: bun run validate && bun run test:theme
scripts.release:check: bun run test && bun run package
